name: Coit Street Garden and Lawn
description: A downtown Florence residence on a full-property maintenance plan: mowed and edged lawns, mulched beds, pruned shrubs, and seasonal color in the gardens, urns, hanging baskets, and containers.
story: This Coit Street house sits on a downtown Florence lot with a wraparound porch, brick walks, palms, and garden rooms that have to look finished from the street and still take daily use. The work here is the whole maintenance program, not a one-time install. Lawn visits keep the turf mowed, edged, and blown clean along the walks and patio. Beds stay mulched and weeded, shrubs and hedges are pruned to the house, and spent growth is cut back when the season turns. Seasonal color carries the property: annuals and coleus in the front beds, hanging baskets on the porch, and layered urns and containers along the brick wall, flagstone, and entry steps. The result is a historic downtown landscape that stays presentation-ready—crisp edges, healthy turf, and color that changes with the year instead of a yard that only looks tended after a big cleanup.
